initial_failure_explanation: The fixed 300000 filler repetitions exceeded the v1 frame byte limit at 64k before token overflow. The fixture now scales with context_window; original overflow assertions pass in the targeted rerun.

limitations: Four text samples per variant per capacity; timing variation is not a stable speedup claim.
Vision timings are individual samples. SDK first-image timings exclude service startup; cached CLI attachment timings reuse the image embedding cache.
Visual budgets 70..1120 are passed through supported engine capabilities; real frontend quality cases use the default 280.
Synchronous preparation cannot be interrupted on the server; cancellation stops subsequent generation.
